findings.what: Phone till held sideways at 844x390 (an ordinary phone in landscape) is 768 px wide or more, so the app swaps the phone till for the desk till: the family form handed to the parent disappears and, turned upright again, the phone is back at Select Customer Type with the sale gone (nothing written). The lane's sideways rule (PHONE_SCROLL under 520 px of height) never gets to act at that size.

At 740x360 sideways the form keeps the phone layout and the heading scrolls away, but the scrolling part is 140 px of 360 (39 %); the Still-needed line with Done (131 px) and Return phone to staff (89 px) take the rest.
Returning review on a dark display: "Ask the team to remove a child" is text-destructive = #7f1d1d on navy, 1.9:1 (light display 4.6:1).
French form at 600 wide: the eyebrow "EN TRAIN DE JOUER CHEZ NOUS AUJOURD'HUI" runs 28 px under the language button (other languages clear).
findings.where: apps/pos/src/components/till/PublicConsentCapture.tsx:595 (absolute top-4 right-4 button) and :599 (the centred eyebrow)

findings.what: "Ask the team" pressed while the display is cut off does not go by itself on the reconnect: still locked under the Retry bar 12.4 s after the connection came back; Retry pressed freed it (the brief calls this the old behaviour). The Retry bar and the status lines push the form down 56 px while locked.
findings.where: apps/pos/src/pages/Display.tsx (resend effects only for display.set_language and a fill; lib/displaySendQueue.ts goesAgainByItself)

findings.what: The returning family's review has no language button, so a language cannot be chosen there at all (offline or not).

The first screen with ไทย chosen offline locks (inert) under a Retry bar and the reconnecting line, which push the screen down so the heading is cut; it frees itself 1.5 s after the connection returns (as expected).
The category arrows sit 8 px inside the row's ends, so an 8 px sliver of the next category shows outside each arrow (e.g. the orange chosen tile left of "Earlier categories").
findings.where: apps/pos/src/components/shared/CategoryRow.tsx:95-98 (arrows at left-0/right-0 of the wrapper, the row wider than it)

findings.what: In English the reconnecting notice wraps to two lines at 600 wide (57 px) and covers the eyebrow line; in Thai one line (37 px).

An open display page cannot learn of a newer build: /display renders outside the staff tree, where ServiceWorkerUpdater is mounted, so it neither registers nor applies a new build; nothing on the page showed any sign of one (there was none to find).
findings.where: apps/pos/src/App.tsx:221 (/display route) against App.tsx:207 (ServiceWorkerUpdater in the staff tree)

findings.what: Checked and fine: a wheel over the row with a dish dialog open is caught by the dialog overlay (row does not move); the arrows work with a finger tap (210 px each) and a touch swipe moves the row; the till half's language list on a light staff theme reads (13.7:1 light, 17.0:1 dark); Thai, Chinese and Russian forms at 600 wide showed no cut or spilling words.
